description.value: You spew caustic chemicals in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30], dealing @Damage[12d6[acid]|options:area-damage] damage to each creature in the area with a basic @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. Once activated, Gunk Spray can't be used again for [[/r 1d4 #Recharge Gunk Spray]]{1d4 rounds}.
